rules.statement: Paraveni nilakarayas are not bound to cultivate fields outside the nindagama, but they must provide personal services within the Kandyan Province upon notice from the proprietor.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think it is unreasonable to require his attendance at the owner's usual place of residence. In the old days, when the great families spent much of their time in Kandy in attendance on the king, their tenants from distant villages were bound to attend at the Kandy walawwa on the days fixed for service."
